decisions.reason: After a 2019 launch with no continued web-market presence through 2021, this adjacent product appears to have revealed limited traction, so its option value no longer justifies tying up engineering and support capacity.

Although it builds on the core offer, the lack of visible market continuation after launch suggests the market test has largely resolved negatively, making redeployment of resources to stronger core filtration lines the better choice.

Because this close-to-core filter was only visibly promoted at launch and not thereafter, the firm has likely learned enough about weak demand to abandon it and focus on established products and newer options.
